purpose: Scientific eligibility for an Arctic paper corpus. This policy does not generate QA findings or evaluate models.

core_geography.latitude_first_rule: An actual observation, sample, field site, modeled domain, or reported result at or north of 66.56 degrees north is Arctic on land or sea. A missing marine region name cannot override an explicit qualifying latitude.
core_geography.actual_study_evidence_only: Coordinates and location names must describe actual study activity or a reported result. Titles, affiliations, background statements, citations, temperature values, and longitude values do not prove study geography.
core_geography.named_region_fallback: When coordinates are absent, use only a documented bounded named region that is wholly north of 66.56 degrees north.
core_geography.boundary_crossing_region_rule: A region that crosses 66.56 degrees north requires evidence for a separable northern site, domain, stratum, or result.
core_geography.mixed_study_rule: Retain a separable Arctic component and restrict downstream findings and questions to its evidence spans. Keep a whole-paper aggregate uncertain when its Arctic component is not separable.
core_geography.failure_rule: Fail geography only when all actual study activity is outside the boundary or the Arctic reference is incidental.

inclusion: Actual study-setting evidence meets the core geography rule for the whole study or a separable component.
Source access and rights permit private analysis.
No accessible retraction or result-changing unresolved correction evidence.
exclusion: Review, editorial, nonresearch, or source without primary findings.
Duplicate version when a preferred published version exists.
All actual study activity is outside the Arctic boundary or Arctic references are incidental.
Sensitive knowledge or location without approved handling.
pending_rules: Metadata discovery never proves the study setting.
A mixed study remains uncertain when its Arctic findings are not separable.
A boundary-crossing named region remains uncertain without northern-site evidence.
Missing access is independent from scientific eligibility.
Preprints and version families remain separate until version relation is established.
Unknown correction or retraction status is recorded as unknown.
languages: No language restriction at discovery. English-readable full text is required for this automated text-screening run.
